# Variable `CONVERSION_CMD`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

This variable is used for storing image conversion commands. Image conversion can convert an image into different objects like:

- Compressed version of the image

- Checksums for the image

An example of CONVERSION_CMD from image_types class is:

```
CONVERSION_CMD:lzo = "lzop -9 ${IMAGE_NAME}${IMAGE_NAME_SUFFIX}.${type}"

```

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-CONVERSION_CMD
